description: This file defines the 'MyClaimRequestAPI' class, a REST API controller for handling claim requests related to the logged-in user in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests, extending functionality from a parent class, and integrates OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing the current user's claim requests, including creation, retrieval, and listing operations, with OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new claim request by invoking the parent class method.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim request by ID, delegated to the parent class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists claim requests for the current user, with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination, delegated to the parent class.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided employee number belongs to the current user; always returns true for self.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating claim requests.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single claim request by ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Provides search filter parameters for listing claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Generates the API response object for a list of claim requests, selecting models based on the specified 'model' parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Enforces that claim requests are filtered for the logged-in employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing claim requests, including sorting and pagination parameters.
